modelReview.summary: The manuscript is a generic template lacking essential study details: the research question, population, exposure/outcome definitions are missing. Survival probabilities are reported without corresponding time points, no confidence intervals, and no comparative test. The analysis is exploratory but not clearly labeled as such. These issues prevent any meaningful interpretation and would block publication.

findings.title: Missing essential study details
findings.whyItMatters: Without a clear research question, population, exposure, and outcome definitions, the analysis is uninterpretable.
findings.actionableFix: State the pre-specified study question clearly: define the population, treatment groups, outcome (event of interest), and time scale. Provide a complete description of the cohort, including eligibility criteria and data source.

findings.title: Survival probabilities reported without time points
findings.whyItMatters: Survival probability is meaningless without specifying the time point. The manuscript omits the times (493.146 and 354.29) for the reported estimates, making them uninterpretable.
findings.actionableFix: Report survival estimates at a clinically meaningful time point (e.g., 1 year) or at the last observed time, clearly stating the time along with survival probability and its confidence interval.
findings.deterministicVerification: Verify that the time points match the reported probabilities.

findings.title: No confidence intervals for survival estimates
findings.whyItMatters: Point estimates without confidence intervals (despite alpha=0.05) leave the precision of the estimates unknown, impairing reliability assessment.
findings.actionableFix: Report 95% confidence intervals for each survival estimate using Greenwood's formula. Include both text and tables.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the CI calculation is correct and matches standard KM output.

findings.title: No comparative test for two-group design
findings.whyItMatters: Two survival curves are presented but no formal comparison (e.g., log-rank test) is reported, leaving the question of treatment difference unanswered.
findings.actionableFix: Perform and report a log-rank test or Cox proportional hazards model with appropriate diagnostics (e.g., proportional hazards assumption).
findings.deterministicVerification: Ensure the test statistic, degrees of freedom, and p-value are reported.

findings.title: Exploratory posture not disclosed; claims may overstate evidence
findings.whyItMatters: The analysis is explicitly 'exploratory_standard_table' and cannot support paper-ready conclusions, yet the manuscript does not clearly disclose this, potentially misleading readers.
findings.actionableFix: Explicitly state that the analysis is exploratory, not pre-registered, and should not be used for decision-making. Remove any confirmatory language.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the statement matches the 'resultPosture.cannotSupport' list.

findings.title: Complete-case analysis without reporting missingness
findings.whyItMatters: No information on excluded records, reasons for missing data, or comparison of complete vs. incomplete cases is provided, risking selection bias.
findings.actionableFix: Report the initial sample size, number excluded for missing data, and compare characteristics. Consider sensitivity analyses for missingness.
findings.deterministicVerification: Review the raw data to compute missingness proportions and patterns.

findings.title: Template placeholders and meta‑commentary in manuscript
findings.whyItMatters: Lines like 'No reader-facing paper/manuscript artifact was found' appear to be internal QA remnants, not appropriate for a scientific manuscript.
findings.actionableFix: Remove all meta‑commentary and template language; ensure the manuscript is a self‑contained scientific report.

findings.title: Raw data not provided; reproducibility limited
findings.whyItMatters: Without access to the raw data, independent verification of the analysis is impossible, undermining reproducibility claims.
findings.actionableFix: Include the de‑identified raw dataset or a detailed description of how to access it. Provide code/scripts used for data cleaning and analysis.
findings.deterministicVerification: Check that the dataset can be read and that the reported sample size and variables match.

missingEvidence: complete study protocol with pre-specified hypothesis
handling of missing data and exclusions
details of variable definitions (survival_time, event, treatment)
